notes: Zara Home France (zarahome.com/fr, storeId 84009901/catalogId 80209919, same Akamai-interstitial route and itxrest categoryId methodology as the prior verified FR Home-Decor pass in notes/146.md). Site's top-level mega menu carries one dedicated pet category, 'COLLECTION ANIMAUX DE COMPAGNIE' (canonicalName 'PETS COLLECTION', /fr/pets-collection-n1561, categoryId 1020752407) with 6 real leaf children exposed via the site's own '/api/storefront/1/stores/84009901/menu' JSON (canonicalName field gives the English names directly, no translation guesswork needed): TOYS, BEDS, FOOD BOWLS, WASHING AND BRUSHING (grooming), COLLARS AND LEASHES, and CUSTOMISATION. Treated the landing page (n1561) as the grouping row (is_group=true, qty=null) since its own page is a marketing/overview page linking to the 6 leaves, not a distinct product listing. Note the URL slug for the Beds category is 'collection-animaux-compagnie-litieres' (literally 'litters/litter boxes' in French) but the site's own canonicalName ('BEDS'), rendered page title ('Paniers pour animaux' = pet baskets/beds), meta description ('LITS' = 'BEDS'), and internal grid_section_name ('Pet bed pet capsulas') all confirm it is Pet Beds, not cat litter -- labelled per the site's real content, not the misleading slug. CUSTOMISATION (edited-pets-n5724, 4 items) verified via product-detail JSON to contain genuine personalizable leather pet collars (e.g. product 518649522 'COLLIER EN CUIR POUR ANIMAL' / nameEn 'LEATHER PET COLLAR') -- a Tier-1 collars/leashes product under a personalization capsule, not a gift/marketing page, so included as a normal row. No pet-food/consumable or medical/veterinary categories found anywhere on the site; none of the open policy-gap flags apply. Checked full homepage mega-menu link set (27 top-level -nNNNN links) plus the embedded menu JSON tree for any other animal/pet-adjacent branch outside this one node -- none found; all 6 leaves plus the landing node are the complete Pet Care taxonomy on this storefront. All 6 leaf qty values are the productIds array length from /itxrest/3/catalog/store/84009901/80209919/category/<id>/product?showProducts=false&showNoStock=false&withSubCategories=false&languageId=-2&appId=1, read once via the cached serverApp-state embedded in each category page and independently re-read a second time via direct live itxrest calls minutes later -- identical both times, no drift. Site renders no 'N items' header on these grids (consistent with the prior FR Home-Decor pass), so the itxrest productIds count is the authoritative source, same method validated on this platform across 5 prior country passes.
